name: BYD Singapore International Marathon presented by adidas (formerly Standard Chartered Singapore Marathon)
short_description: A full marathon and multi-distance race held in Singapore on December 6, 2025, finishing at The Padang.
ai_summary: The BYD Singapore International Marathon presented by adidas, formerly known as the Standard Chartered Singapore Marathon, is a full-marathon event scheduled for December 6, 2025, in Singapore. Organized by the IRONMAN Group, it offers four distances: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, with the route passing through the Marina Bay area and finishing at The Padang. Registration status has not yet been announced.

core_facts.venue: The Padang (finish); route through the Marina Bay area

faqs.question: When is the BYD Singapore International Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The event is scheduled to take place on December 6, 2025, in Singapore. This date applies to all the race distances offered, including the full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km events, all organized under the same race weekend by the IRONMAN Group.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at this event?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from four distances: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This range allows runners of different experience levels and goals to take part in the same event weekend in Singapore.

faqs.question: Where does the race finish and what route does it follow?
faqs.answer: The race finishes at The Padang, a well-known open field in Singapore. The route takes runners through the Marina Bay area before reaching this finish line, offering a course that passes through central parts of the city.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open for the marathon?
faqs.answer: According to available information, the registration status for this event is listed as 'Not Yet Announced.' This means specific sign-up dates, fees, or procedures have not been released yet, so prospective participants should check back for updates closer to the event.
